settings.title: Accepted Payment Methods
settings.content:
We accept the following payment methods:

  • Credit / Debit Cards: Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, American Express
  • Digital Wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal
  • Pay in 3 Installments: Klarna, Scalapay
  • Regional: iDEAL, Bancontact, Sofort

settings.title: Payment Safety & 3D Secure Protection
settings.content: Purchases on Liu Jo are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption. In addition to CVV verification, transactions implement 3D Secure bank two-factor authentication.

settings.title: Billing Rules & Invoices
settings.content: The purchase of products on the website is reserved for natural persons. Invoices and receipts are emailed automatically upon payment confirmation.

settings.panel_subheading: Every transaction on Liu Jo is processed through advanced technological systems and certified 256-bit SSL encryption.
